allow: PowerShell($ids = @\(12528, 20620, 32348, 24804, 23892\); foreach \($id in $ids\) { $p = Get-WmiObject Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$id" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($p\) { Write-Output "$id : $\($p.ExecutablePath\) | $\($p.CommandLine\)" } })

PowerShell(@\(12528, 20620, 32348, 24804, 23892\) | ForEach-Object { $proc = Get-WmiObject Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$_" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "PID $_ ParentPID $\($proc.ParentProcessId\)" })
